propositions: Directory creation and first event file write must be atomic to prevent fsck-visible empty ticket directories when the writer is interrupted between mkdir and event publish

The fix stages directory and event together in a dot-prefixed temporary path (.tmp-newticket-*) before atomically renaming under the existing write lock, making temp paths invisible to fsck scanners without requiring scanner changes
Both single-event stage_and_commit and batch_stage_and_commit paths now publish through the same StagedEvent.promote() mechanism to eliminate the vulnerable window in both code paths

A bounded best-effort sweep removes stale staging directories owned by provably dead processes at writer startup, using process metadata to defeat pid recycling without violating the 043f non-cleanup boundary

Concurrent creates of different tickets produce distinct staging names via pid and uuid4 suffix, and the write lock discipline remains unchanged so event visibility only occurs after concurrency checks pass
All other mkdir-then-file sites in the store write path have been audited and either converted or explicitly exempted with documented reasons
